note: spec gate r1: a negative scenario pinning half a stated guarantee did not bind. Its distinguishing Given named the absence of the property under test, readable only by an implementation already consulting the record, so the implementation class it targets passes it. Re-cut against a concrete fixture the wrong implementation reaches.

spec gate r1: two summary glosses claimed more than the boundary paragraph adjacent to them, which then retracted the claim. One stated as a lookup-surface definition the exact misreading the node was written to prevent. Off-enum: this is prose contradicting prose within one document, not prose against implementation.

spec gate r2: the sole scenario guarding the CR's central safety property did not bind. Its Then carried a conditional the Given never instantiated, so an implementation ignoring the condition passes under any fixture satisfying it. Resolved by cutting the behavior from this CR rather than re-cutting the scenario; consumer wiring becomes a follow-up. The defective requirement originated in the conductor's own instruction to the producer, not in producer error.

spec gate r2: two glosses upgraded a coherence check to an independent oracle. A record cross-checked against itself is not independent of the agent that wrote it; a uniformly under-reporting agent stays internally consistent and escapes. Second instance of this cause in one mission, across two gate rounds and both node bodies.

spec gate r2: node prose assigned a verdict-consumption contract to a caller whose suite is frozen, untouched, and carries no such scenario — prose naming an owner for an obligation the corpus does not hold. Resolved by removing the assignment; the obligation is filed as a follow-up instead.

spec gate r3: `a directory the run expanded is recorded alongside the files it yielded` binds less than its title and map row claim. The Then asserts only the directory entry, so a directory-only recorder passes. Consequential, not cosmetic: a listing-name hash is invariant under a content edit inside that directory, so check-freshness reads `current` for an edited file the subject loads from a recorded directory — the sibling node's stale verdict fails for that whole class. Remedy is additive.

spec gate r3: `a file the run did not read is absent from the evaluated set` still does not bind. Its second Given is an absence-state that stipulates the run's read-set — the very fact the record is supposed to report — re-anchoring the oracle inside the self-report under test. The directory-glob recorder escapes by vacuity rather than failing. Third instance of the unbindable-Given class in this mission.

spec gate r3: THIRD instance of this cause, and the first authored by the conductor rather than inherited. Three sites in run/README.md read `evaluated` as `what it was computed from` — a fact about the run — where the record can only carry the run's claim; the careful paragraph one screen below forbids exactly that reading. All three sites were introduced by this round's own commits (898e1885, 289bc740), so this is a regression, not a fresh finding. It had already propagated into check-freshness's closed-world section. An independent judge found a FOURTH instance on the other node, inherited: the check-freshness ## What opener claims all four verdicts name non-matching files, which absent and current cannot.

spec gate r3: the ## What section added in 289bc740 moved the **Fit:** line out of ## Use Cases, where aced-fit specifies it, and left ## What carrying a ~25-line trust-boundary essay against the bar's one-or-two-paragraph rule. Both introduced by this round; non-blocking warn, but conductor-authored.

scope: ONE frozen scenario in run.feature: `the run is persisted as a timestamped record`, whose Then names "under the suite's results directory". Cleared to re-point it at the shared aced results directory, reconciling it with its own sibling `run records for a target are kept under the shared aced results directory` and with the concrete path check-freshness pins. No other frozen scenario is in scope; the six scenarios this CR adds are unratified draft and need no clearance to re-cut.
why: a frozen scenario contradicting its sibling cannot be repaired additively — the wrong destination is IN the Then. Surfaced by the cold spec-judge as an out-of-diff observation; the owner chose to fix it here rather than let it reach the impl gate.
